question: Who acted in the most movies?
aql:
FOR e IN acted_in
  COLLECT actor = e._from WITH COUNT INTO movie_count
  SORT movie_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
  RETURN { name: DOCUMENT(actor).name, movie_count }

question: Which movies were released between 1990 and 2000?
aql: FOR m IN movies FILTER m.released >= 1990 AND m.released <= 2000 SORT m.title RETURN { title: m.title, released: m.released }

question: Who has the longest name among all actors?
aql:
FOR p IN persons
  FILTER LENGTH(FOR m IN 1..1 OUTBOUND p acted_in LIMIT 1 RETURN 1) > 0
  SORT CHAR_LENGTH(p.name) DESC
  LIMIT 1
  RETURN p.name

question: List people born before 1940.
aql: FOR p IN persons FILTER p.born != null AND p.born < 1940 SORT p.name RETURN p.name

question: Who was born in 1965 and has directed a movie?
aql:
FOR p IN persons
  FILTER p.born == 1965
  FILTER LENGTH(FOR m IN 1..1 OUTBOUND p directed LIMIT 1 RETURN 1) > 0
  RETURN p.name
